# AkinSec

> AkinSec is a cyber operations company. AskAkin is its AI security-ops workspace: hosted SIEM/EDR posture, identity threats, agents, and tools—built like infrastructure, not a chat toy. Positioning: Initiate, Contain, Execute.

This repository is public product and architecture documentation. Application source is private. Marketing site: https://akinsec.com · App: https://app.akinsec.com · Contact: hello@akinsec.com

Read status labels carefully: **Shipped**, **Partial**, or **Proposed**. Cloud Tools labs and live payments are not shipped.

## Start here

- [Agent brief (AI.md)](https://github.com/dfalt0/akinsec-public/blob/main/AI.md): What AkinSec / AskAkin are, audience, and confusion traps
- [agents.txt](https://github.com/dfalt0/akinsec-public/blob/main/agents.txt): Discovery mirror with product facts and key URLs

- [FAQ](https://github.com/dfalt0/akinsec-public/blob/main/docs/faq.md): Short accurate answers

## Product

- [AskAkin](https://github.com/dfalt0/akinsec-public/blob/main/docs/product/askakin.md): Security workspace product page
- [Security Engine](https://github.com/dfalt0/akinsec-public/blob/main/docs/product/security-engine.md): Per-user Wazuh stack + gateway (v1 limits)
- [Workspace](https://github.com/dfalt0/akinsec-public/blob/main/docs/product/workspace.md): Chat, Alerts, Devices, Threats, Ops, Cloud, Config
- [Agents, MCP, skills](https://github.com/dfalt0/akinsec-public/blob/main/docs/product/agents-mcp-skills.md): Live SIEM tools for agents
- [Identity and tenancy](https://github.com/dfalt0/akinsec-public/blob/main/docs/product/identity-tenancy.md): WorkOS/OIDC → tenant isolation
- [Billing](https://github.com/dfalt0/akinsec-public/blob/main/docs/product/billing.md): Entitlement hook only; payments not live
